chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: What payment options and methods are accepted?

chunks.text: You can pay using a credit card, debit card, or electronic bank transfer (EFT). Both full payment (one-pay, which avoids installment fees) and monthly 12-installment payment plans are available.
